sections.title: Interrogative Sentences (Wh- Questions)
sections.content:
Wh- प्रश्नों में पहले Question word को समझना जरूरी है।

1. Who → By whom
Example: Who wrote this letter?
Step 1: 'Who' doer है, इसलिए Passive में 'By whom' बनेगा।
Step 2: Helping verb (was) लगाएँ।
Step 3: V3 (written) प्रयोग करें।
Step 4: Question form बनाए रखें।
Answer: By whom was this letter written?

2. Whom → Who
Example: Whom did you help?
Step 1: 'Whom' object है, इसलिए Passive में Subject बनेगा।
Step 2: 'did' हटाएँ और Tense पहचानें (Past Simple)।
Step 3: was + V3 लगाएँ।
Step 4: Who को Subject की तरह रखें।
Answer: Who was helped by you?

sections.title: Imperative Sentences
sections.content:
Imperative वाक्य आदेश, निवेदन या सलाह देते हैं।

1. सामान्य आदेश
Example: Close the door.
Step 1: Object पहचानें (the door)।
Step 2: 'Let' से वाक्य शुरू करें।
Step 3: be + V3 लगाएँ।
Answer: Let the door be closed.

2. Request/Order
Example: Open the window.
Step 1: भावना समझें (request/order)।
Step 2: You are requested/ordered का प्रयोग करें।
Step 3: to + V1 लगाएँ।
Answer: You are requested to open the window.

sections.title: Fixed Prepositions (जहाँ 'by' का प्रयोग नहीं होता)
sections.content:
कुछ verbs के साथ निश्चित preposition आते हैं। Passive में भी वही preposition रहेगा।

Example 1: Everyone knows him.
Step 1: Passive बनाएं → He is known to everyone.
('known to' रहेगा, 'by' नहीं लगेगा)

Example 2: The news surprised me.
Step 1: Object को Subject बनाएं।
Step 2: was + V3 लगाएँ।
Step 3: fixed preposition 'at' बनाए रखें।
Answer: I was surprised at the news.

Example 3: They filled the glass with water.
Answer: The glass was filled with water.
('with' बना रहेगा)

sections.title: Phrasal Verbs का Conversion
sections.content:
Phrasal verbs में verb + preposition/adverb होता है। Passive में पूरा phrase साथ रहेगा।

Example 1: She looks after the baby.
Step 1: Object पहचानें (the baby)।
Step 2: is + V3 लगाएँ (looked after)।
Step 3: पूरा phrasal verb रखें।
Answer: The baby is looked after by her.

Example 2: They laughed at him.
Step 1: Object (him) को Subject बनाएं।
Step 2: was + V3 लगाएँ।
Step 3: 'at' बना रहे।
Answer: He was laughed at by them.

sections.title: महत्वपूर्ण नियम
sections.content:
1. Question form में helping verb पहले आता है।
2. Imperative में अक्सर 'Let' या 'You are requested' प्रयोग होता है।
3. Fixed preposition को कभी न बदलें।
4. Phrasal verb को अलग न करें।

sections.title: सामान्य गलतियाँ
sections.content:
1. Who/Whom गलत बदल देना।
2. Imperative में be + V3 भूल जाना।
3. Fixed preposition हटाकर 'by' लगा देना।
4. Phrasal verb को तोड़ देना।

sections.title: त्वरित सारांश
sections.content: Wh- प्रश्नों में संरचना बनाए रखें। Imperative में 'Let' या 'You are requested' प्रयोग करें। Fixed prepositions और phrasal verbs को ज्यों का त्यों रखें। Passive बनाते समय Tense और structure नहीं बदलना चाहिए।

tricks.title: Who से By whom ट्रिक
tricks.explanation: यदि Who doer है तो Passive में By whom से शुरू करें।
tricks.example: Who taught you? → By whom were you taught?

tricks.title: Whom को Subject बनाएं
tricks.explanation: Whom object है, इसलिए Passive में Who बन जाएगा।
tricks.example: Whom did she call? → Who was called by her?

tricks.title: Imperative = Let + Object
tricks.explanation: साधारण आदेश में Let + object + be + V3।
tricks.example: Clean the room. → Let the room be cleaned.

tricks.title: Request Formula
tricks.example: Help me. → You are requested to help me.

tricks.title: Fixed Preposition याद रखें
tricks.explanation: Verb के साथ जो preposition है वही रखें।
tricks.example: Known to, surprised at, filled with

tricks.title: Phrasal Verb पूरा रखें
tricks.explanation: Verb + preposition को अलग न करें।

tricks.title: Question Structure बचाएं
tricks.explanation: Helping verb को Subject से पहले रखें।
tricks.example: Was the work done by him?

tricks.title: Pronoun Correction
tricks.explanation: him → he, me → I, them → they।
